args.subject: Update: Reshipping Fee Refund on Hold
args.body:
Dear Adatum Ltd,

We have identified a discrepancy in your contract records. The shipping address associated with your contract (Austin DC) does not match the intended destination (Rotterdam DC-TOAR) for your recent reshipment. As a result, we must verify this information before proceeding with the refund.

**Next Steps:**
- We will escalate this ticket to our **Compliance & Contracts Team** for validation of the correct shipping site.
- An updated resolution will be shared within **24–48 hours**.

Thank you for your patience. For urgent matters, reply to this email.

Regards,
IT Ops Team
Ticket C-1730

args.reason: Contract system reveals ship_site = Austin DC (not Rotterdam DC-TOAR as initially referenced). Refund eligibility invalid. Requires manual review by Compliance & Contracts Team to resolve discrepancy. Archive export and refund blocked by platform policy.
